headline: Nigerian Naira Supported by Higher Crude Oil Prices and Rising Reserves
summary: The Nigerian naira entered the month with a stable outlook, backed by Bonny Light crude prices reaching $115 per barrel, increased oil production, and central bank foreign reserves of $55 billion.
why: The Central Bank of Nigeria relies on foreign exchange reserves and crude exports to stabilize the local currency and defend capital inflows.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Higher oil export receipts and rising central bank foreign exchange reserves strengthen local currency stability.
